facts.fact: Act 23 of 2025 amending the Cybercrimes and Other Related Crimes Act 2021 was passed by the National Assembly on 15 December 2025 and assented by the President on 22 December 2025, widening the offences and adding search and interception powers; it amends an Act already in operation and states no commencement date of its own.
